description.p: Arkx is a fast, multi-threaded archive manager for Linux. Open, browse and extract ZIP, 7Z, RAR, TAR and 20+ more formats from a clean GTK4 interface or the terminal.

ul.li: Never hangs: every job runs on a background worker, fully cancellable
Honest byte-based progress with speed, ETA and a details pane
Hybrid backends: native Rust streaming for ZIP/TAR plus multithreaded 7z for RAR/7Z/ISO/CAB, with automatic fallback
Dolphin file-manager integration: Compress/Extract service menus and a progress window
Perf: parallel zip creation, per-entry extract progress, multithreaded xz
Fixed: cancel-aware extraction, password-aware edits, zip-bomb quota enforced on all backends
Feature: checksums, inline rename, multi-volume creation
Feature: archive comments, native AES-256 zip, format conversion, multi-volume split
